glosses: A sauce and/or dip of varying textures with a typical base of tomatoes, onion, and chili peppers.

examples.text: Tom hizo salsa de toma de cero.
examples.en: Tom made tomato sauce from scratch.

examples.text: La variedad es la salsa de la vida.
examples.en: Variety is the spice of life.

examples.text: Eso no es sangre, es salsa de tomates.
examples.en: It isn't blood. It's tomato sauce.

examples.text: Ni voy a preguntar por qué hay salsa en el techo.
examples.en: I'm not even going to ask why there's sauce on the ceiling.
